claims: Assess and manage worsening hypoxemia and tachypnea on 2 L/min nasal cannula, with SpO2 93% and pO2 85 mmHg, considering escalation of respiratory support.
Monitor blood pressure closely given multiple mean arterial pressures below 65 mmHg and consider adjustment of vasopressor therapy.
Obtain repeat blood gas and consider chest imaging to evaluate for pulmonary embolism or other causes of respiratory deterioration.
